lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct high-contrast vertical line segments; spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-torso with increased density observed in the anterior shoulder region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation identified on the 4th vertical line from the posterior, splitting into two segments approximately two-thirds toward the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Abbreviated line segments observed on the posterior haunch; the first posterior-most line terminates at the mid-thigh level.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Group of 5 distinct high-contrast spots located on the posterior-lateral thigh region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots align to form a semi-horizontal geometric line on the mid-posterior haunch.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate curvature with a posterior-upward trajectory curving inward at the apical ends relative to the cranial base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Approximate 1.5:1 ratio of tip-to-tip pixel distance relative to the combined width of the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.15 of the total horn length consists of high-contrast ivory/white tipping.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of high-contrast white chevrons on the bridge of the nose, distinct white spots on the cheeks, and white transverse bands on the lower limbs.
